motivation: Test the user's late-entry complaint as an execution/entry-location intervention, not an additional indicator veto.
disclosed_prior_results: Original 3 close-confirmed hypotheses, fixed meta layer and hourly EMA adaptation failed the prior long-history evaluation; those results are retained, not relabelled.

range_edge_limit.entry: known box edge plus 0.1 ATR inward
range_edge_limit.regime: no two aligned 15m moves with aligned 5m EMA9/21 opposing this trade

trend_value_limit.direction: two completed aligned 15m close changes and 5m EMA9/21 direction/slope
trend_value_limit.stop: 2 ATR beyond planned entry or known last-5-bar extreme plus 0.25 ATR, whichever is wider

preplanned_break_stop.entry: known range edge plus 0.1 ATR outside
preplanned_break_stop.stop: opposite range edge plus 0.25 ATR, minimum 2 ATR
preplanned_break_stop.target: one known box width beyond planned entry

common.cost_model: same 0.06% each-side fee, 0.02% each-side adverse execution and conservative archived funding; 2x execution-cost stress
common.profit_protection: observe minute closes only; after max(original price risk, 2*modeled breakeven distance) favorable movement, monotonic quarter-net-peak guard with half-ATR breathing, effective next minute and updates on new completed 5m boundary

evaluation.2024_2025: development diagnostics; no parameter changes after inspection
evaluation.2026_Jan_Sep: exploratory because other family outcomes have already been inspected; not a newly untouched final test
evaluation.2023: separate blind historical robustness check with fixed rules, not prospective or future-trained ML; do not claim it was deployed historically
evaluation.familywise_uncertainty: report all new and old attempts; use 99% day-block lower bound as a stricter screening statistic

native_lbank_requirement: External evidence alone does not certify native execution, warning behavior, fills, or guarantee a profit improvement.
